name: interviewhub
description: LinkedIn ile kabul edilen başvurular için video konferans odaları (web + Chrome eklentisi)

scripts.build: npm run build -w @ih/server && npm run build -w @ih/web && npm run build -w @ih/extension
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @ih/server && npm run typecheck -w @ih/web && npm run typecheck -w @ih/extension
scripts.test: npm run typecheck && npm run test:signal
scripts.test:all: npm run typecheck && npm run test:signal && npm run test:e2e && npm run test:ext
